question: interface[] of scripts/dossier/schema.json has no term for a proxy protocol or for a static list file. Add socks4, socks5 and http-proxy (an HTTP or HTTPS forward proxy, including HTTP CONNECT) and one term for a static text file fetched with an unauthenticated HTTPS GET (for example static-file)?
why: AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12: a value that fits no term extends the vocabulary. ip-proxy/thespeedx-proxy-list reaches its three lists (http.txt, socks4.txt, socks5.txt) as static text files over HTTPS, its lines speak HTTP CONNECT, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5, and it carries rest as the nearest token; with the terms its interface[] would read static-file, http-proxy, socks4 and socks5, and its extras.interface_enum_gap, which names socks5, http-proxy and static-file access, should name socks4 as well. ip-proxy/netnut-seized keeps unknown whatever the vocabulary: on 2026-11-02 netnut.io and netnut.com still answered HTTP 200 with the page titled Seized by the Federal Bureau of Investigation, and the Wayback Machine copy of netnut.io of 2026-06-17 names no proxy protocol, so no protocol of its endpoint is observed or documented. The same gap is queued for brightdata-residential and soax-mobile (queue item 20261030-1751-amend-ip-proxy-dc89-u01-q04), oxylabs-isp-proxies and decodo-isp-proxies (u02-q02), iproyal-isp-proxies and linkstatic-c-class (u03-q04) and webshare-free-plan (20261030-1250-verify-ip-proxy-efa4-u01-q03).
